title: Grey matter volume differences in pediatric obsessive-compulsive disorder: a meta-analysis of voxel-based morphometry studies.
authors: Li L, Liu Y, Luo T, Tao Y, Zhao S, Liu P, Yang Z, Jiang Y, Zhang M, Duan X, Situ M, Huang Y.

Meta-regression analysis results.  a  GM volume in the left IFG was significantly negatively associated with the mean age in pediatric OCD patients.  b  GM volume in the left MOG was significantly negatively associated with the male ratio in pediatric OCD patients.  c  GM volume in the left SFG (orbital part) was significantly positively associated with CYBOCS score in pediatric OCD patients.  d
